links.comparator_used: Prompt A (write a handout 'easily understandable by an average American') with no specific grade level or readability formula
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated paediatric cataract handouts (SMOG, FKGL)
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 prompt B responses were more readable than prompt A responses (p<0.001); ChatGPT-4 prompt B outputs had SMOG 5.59±0.5 and FKGL 4.31±0.7
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 prompt B responses were more readable than prompt A responses (p<0.001).

links.comparator_used: Original existing paediatric cataract patient education materials (before LLM rewriting)
links.outcome: Readability of existing PEMs after LLM rewriting to a sixth-grade level (SMOG)
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 consistently rewrote materials to or below the specified sixth-grade reading level (SMOG: 5.14±0.3); all LLM responses had high quality (DISCERN ≥4), understandability (≥70%) and accuracy (Likert=1)
links.tradeoff: All LLM-generated responses were not actionable (<70%)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 generated more readable responses (lower SMOG and FKGL scores; 5.59±0.5 and 4.31±0.7, respectively) than the other two LLMs (p<0.001) and consistently rewrote them to or below the specified sixth-grade reading level (SMOG: 5.14±0.3).
